risk_if_not_implemented: Without AI TEVV Privacy Assessment, Personal Data (PD) may be collected, processed, retained or shared without lawful authority or adequate safeguards, harming individuals and exposing the organization to regulatory action. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to R-EX-5, R-GV-6, R-GV-9, R-GV-10, R-AI-2, R-IP-6, and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of AI TEVV Privacy Assessment (AAT-28.7) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: AI & Autonomous Technologies Production Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor the functionality and behavior of the deployed Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT).
compensating_control_2.justification: AI & Autonomous Technologies Production Monitoring (AAT-36) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of AI TEVV Privacy Assessment (AAT-28.7) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
